Name: StardewLocations
Author: Mizzion
Description:
This simple mod shows your current location while changing maps. The names are based off of the wiki map names.

The map names are fully translatable. You can send me your translations and ill update the mod :)

[size=4]How to Install the Mod:[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of SMAPI (Currently 2.5.2): https://smapi.io
[*]Unzip the StardewLocations folder from the ZIP file you downloaded here.
[*]Put the StardewLocations folder inside your "Stardew Valley/Mods" folder.
[*]Run the game. It should be working now.
[/list]
